issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated directly into URL paths without path-segment encoding, so IDs containing '/', '?', or '#' can change the requested endpoint.
Paginated list methods silently treat missing or malformed 'items' as an empty page and skip malformed entries instead of raising an API-contract error.
batch_create silently drops malformed or missing result entries and never verifies that the API returned one result per submitted task.
batch_create materializes the entire iterable before chunking, contradicting the README's 'any number of tasks' claim and risking unbounded memory use.
Retry-After only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date Retry-After values.
Transport/network errors from httpx are not wrapped in LumenAPIError, so callers must handle inconsistent exception types.
max_attempts is not validated, so zero or negative values produce a misleading 'request was not attempted' failure instead of configuration validation.
Runtime values assigned to Literal-typed fields are not validated, allowing invalid API statuses or verdicts into typed models.
Frozen dataclasses expose mutable dict fields directly, so model instances are not actually immutable.
Package is advertised as typed but does not include a py.typed marker or package-data configuration for PEP 561 consumers.
Documentation claims batch_create accepts any number of tasks, but the implementation loads the full iterable into memory first.
